suggestions.assertion: 步骤清单里明确写出调用 sibling_spec_probe.py 的完整命令行, 含 `--own-spec-dir` 与 `--repo-path` 两个参数 (只写「跑探针」不写命令行不算)
suggestions.reason: The assertion only checks flag presence. The prompt hands the spec as a path (`openspec/changes/demo-spec/`), and the script requires the directory NAME; an answer writing `--own-spec-dir openspec/changes/demo-spec/` would pass this assertion yet produce exit 2 at runtime (script looks for repo/openspec/changes/<arg>/proposal.md). Consider requiring the value be exactly `demo-spec` (and `--repo-path` be `/work/Demo`). This run got it right (line 13, 39) but the assertion would not have caught the wrong form.

suggestions.assertion: `### Round 2` 记录里渲染了一条带 🔴 的探针结果行, 写明检测到 1 份同 issue 的竞品 Spec 且标注该命中是「已完成的 Spec」(命中在 archive/ 下)
suggestions.reason: execution-modes.md:199 requires the rendered row to include `<spec_dir 列表>`. An answer that writes the 🔴 count + 「已完成的 Spec」 but omits the spec_dir name `2026-08-22-phase-c-integrator-ci-path-coverage` would pass this assertion while failing the '由人一眼可辨' purpose. Consider requiring the spec_dir to appear in the rendered line.

No assertion covers the fail-closed consumption contract (read first-class `verdict`, not infer from `hits`; check exit==0 / parseable JSON / schema_version=="1"; degraded status appends 覆盖不完整). This run did all of it (lines 46-56) unprompted. If another eval in the suite already targets the not_established/degraded branch this is fine; otherwise the 'happy path' eval lets an answer that infers from hits[] pass unnoticed.

No assertion checks that the probe hit is NOT promoted into a conclusion_record / severity / `## 审计结论` section. That is the concrete mechanism behind 'does not change verdict'; an answer could assert 'advisory' in prose while also listing the hit as a Major finding, which would pass assertion 3 literally. This run explicitly excluded it (line 70, 117).

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are discriminating on the four intended axes (command line / render wording / advisory / per-round vs Step 0) and this run passes all four with citations that verify against the skill source. Gaps are in value-correctness (dir name vs path, spec_dir in the row) and in the fail-closed / non-promotion mechanics, which the run handled but the assertions do not test. No metrics.json or user_notes.md in outputs; timing.json: 314.3s, 112713 tokens.
